Section: NATIONAL AGRICULTURAL RESEARCH CENTRE (NARC) - POTATO RESEARCH PROGRAM
Title: Integrated Management of Potato Late Blight and Early Blight in Punjab
Publication Year: 2024 | Document Ref: NARC-POTATO-2024-V2

Section: 1.1: Potato Late Blight (Pachita Jhalsao - Phytophthora infestans) Management
Epidemiology: Devastating disease active during cool, humid, foggy weather (10-18C, RH >85%) in Okara, Sahiwal, and Pakpattan.
Diagnostic Symptoms: Rapid water-soaked irregular lesions on leaf tips and margins turning dark purplish-black with white mildew underneath.
Recommended Treatment Protocol:
- Preventive: Spray Mancozeb 80% WP @ 600 to 800 grams per acre or Propineb (Antracol) @ 600g/acre before canopy closure.
- Curative Protocol: At first symptom, apply Metalaxyl + Mancozeb (Ridomil Gold) @ 250 grams per 100 liters of water,
  or Mandipropamid (Revus 250 SC) @ 200 ml per acre, or Dimethomorph (Acrobat) @ 250 grams per acre.
- Spray timing: Ensure total coverage of both upper and lower foliage surfaces using hollow-cone nozzles.
Section: NATIONAL AGRICULTURAL RESEARCH CENTRE (NARC) - POTATO PROGRAM (PAGE 2)

Section: 1.2: Potato Early Blight (Agaita Jhalsao) and Insect Pest Management
Early Blight (Alternaria solani):
- Diagnostic Symptoms: Circular dark brown spots with concentric target-board rings on older leaves.
- Chemical Spray Protocol: Difenoconazole (Score 250 EC) @ 125 ml/acre or Azoxystrobin + Difenoconazole @ 200 ml/acre.
Insect Pest and Keera Management (Aphids, Tuber Moth, Cutworm):
- Myzus persicae (Aphid vector): Spray Flonicamid (Ulala 50 WG) @ 60 grams/acre to halt virus transmission.
- Cutworm (Chor Keera / Agrotis ipsilon): Apply Chlorpyrifos 40 EC @ 1000 ml/acre with first irrigation.
- Potato Tuber Moth (Gudam Keera): Spray Emamectin Benzoate 1.9 EC @ 200 ml/acre before final earthing up.
Section: NATIONAL AGRICULTURAL RESEARCH CENTRE (NARC) - POTATO PROGRAM (PAGE 3)

Section: 1.3: Potato Nutrition, Urea Splitting and Tuber Rot Prevention
Fertilizer Regimen for High Yield (300+ Maunds/Acre in Autumn Crop):
- Basal Application: 2 bags DAP + 2 bags SOP (Potassium Sulfate) + 1 bag Ammonium Sulfate at planting.
- Nitrogen Schedule: 2 bags Urea applied split: 1 bag at emergence (20 days) and 1 bag before earthing up (35 days).
- Avoid late urea application after 45 days as it delays tuber bulking and induces hollow heart.
Tuber Soft Rot & Black Scurf Prevention:
- Seed treatment with Pencycuron (Monceren) @ 250 ml per 100 kg seed tubers.
- Stop irrigation 10-12 days before vine killing to allow skin maturation.

Section: NATIONAL AGRICULTURAL RESEARCH CENTRE (NARC) ISLAMABAD
Title: Solanaceous Crop Pathology: Early and Late Blight Diagnostic Protocols
Publication Year: 2024 | Document Ref: NARC-VEG-PATH-2024

Section: 4.1: Potato and Tomato Blight Field Guide
Diagnostic Differentiation:
- Early Blight (Alternaria solani): Distinct target-like concentric rings on older leaves, warm dry conditions.
- Late Blight (Phytophthora infestans): Water-soaked lesions turning purplish-black rapidly in cool foggy weather.
Chemical Spray Protocols:
- Preventive: Mancozeb 80% WP @ 600g per acre or Copper Hydroxide @ 500g per acre.
- Curative: Metalaxyl + Mancozeb (Ridomil Gold) @ 250g per acre or Dimethomorph @ 200g per acre.

Section: GOVERNMENT OF THE PUNJAB - DIRECTORATE OF AGRICULTURE EXTENSION
Title: Tomato Disease Diagnostic Compendium and Spray Schedule
Publication Year: 2024 | Document Ref: PB-AGRI-TOMATO-2024

Section: 2.1: Tomato Early Blight (Alternaria solani) and Leaf Spot Management
Diagnostic Symptoms: Concentric brown target rings on lower foliage, progressive yellow chlorosis, stem girdling.
Chemical Treatment Protocol:
- Spray Chlorothalonil 75 WP @ 500 grams per acre or Mancozeb 80 WP @ 600g per 100 liters of water.
- For advancing blight: Apply Difenoconazole (Score) @ 125 ml/acre mixed with Azoxystrobin @ 100 ml/acre.
Cultural Controls:
- Prune lower 8 inches of diseased leaves touching soil bed to prevent rain splash infection.
- Use staked trellising or tunnel mulching to improve air circulation.
Section: GOVERNMENT OF THE PUNJAB - DIRECTORATE OF AGRICULTURE EXTENSION (PAGE 2)

Section: 2.2: Tomato Late Blight, Bacterial Spot and Fruit Rot Control
Late Blight (Phytophthora infestans) in Tunnel Tomatoes:
- Rapid vine wilting, water-soaked black lesions on green fruit and foliage during fog.
- Curative Spray: Metalaxyl + Mancozeb (Ridomil Gold) @ 250 grams per acre or Cymoxanil @ 300g/acre.
Bacterial Spot (Xanthomonas vesicatoria):
- Small dark water-soaked leaf spots with yellow halos, scab-like rough fruit lesions.
- Treatment: Copper Hydroxide (Kocide 2000) @ 500 grams/acre + Kasugamycin @ 250 ml/acre.
Section: GOVERNMENT OF THE PUNJAB - DIRECTORATE OF AGRICULTURE EXTENSION (PAGE 3)

Section: 2.3: Tomato Leaf Curl Virus (TYLCV), Whitefly and Fruit Borer Management
Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl Virus (Patta Maror):
- Transmitted exclusively by Whitefly (Bemisia tabaci). Symptoms: Upward leaf curling, stunted bushy growth.
- Vector Spray: Pyriproxyfen 10.8 EC @ 500 ml/acre or Spirotetramat (Movento) @ 125 ml/acre.
Tomato Fruit Borer (Tamatar ki Sundi - Helicoverpa armigera):
- Circular bore holes in ripening fruit.
- Spray Emamectin Benzoate 1.9 EC @ 200 ml/acre or Chlorantraniliprole (Coragen) @ 50 ml/acre with 3-day PHI.

Section: GOVERNMENT OF THE PUNJAB - DIRECTORATE OF AGRICULTURE EXTENSION
Title: Comprehensive Wheat Production Guidelines & Sowing Calendar
Publication Year: 2024 | Document Ref: PB-AGRI-WHEAT-2024

Section: 5.1: Wheat Fertilizer Schedule
- Basal Application: 1.5 bags DAP + 1 bag SOP at seedbed preparation.
- Nitrogen Schedule: 1 bag Urea at 1st irrigation (Crown root stage, 20-25 days) and 1 bag Urea at 2nd irrigation.

Section: UNIVERSITY OF AGRICULTURE FAISALABAD (UAF) - DEPARTMENT OF AGRONOMY
Title: Vegetable Soil Fertility, Irrigation Scheduling and Micronutrient Compendium
Publication Year: 2024 | Document Ref: UAF-AGRON-VEG-2024

Section: 3.1: Potato and Tomato Micronutrient Deficiencies: Zinc, Boron and Calcium
Blossom End Rot in Tomato: Caused by Calcium deficiency under fluctuating soil moisture.
- Remedy: Foliar spray of Calcium Chloride or Calcium Nitrate @ 500 grams per 100 liters of water at fruit set.
Zinc Deficiency in Potato: Small leaves with upward curled margins and brown spotting.
- Broadcast Zinc Sulfate 33% at 6 kg per acre at planting or foliar spray chelated Zinc @ 200g/acre.
Section: UNIVERSITY OF AGRICULTURE FAISALABAD (UAF) (PAGE 2)

Section: 3.2: Drip Irrigation and Fertigation Timings for Solanaceous Crops
Watering Intervals for High Beds and Tunnels:
- Maintain soil moisture tension at 25-30 kPa; avoid water stagnation in furrow beds which triggers Phytophthora rot.
- Fertigation schedule: Apply Potassium Nitrate (13-0-45) @ 5 kg/acre weekly during tuber/fruit bulking.
